description: uDALES provides large-eddy simulation of urban flow with heat and pollutant processes. Its open repository includes documentation, examples and tests for the research code. Users supply urban geometry, atmospheric forcing and numerical settings. The code supports physical urban-environment studies, while resolved detail and computational cost depend on the configured grid and scenario. Published by uDALES developers. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: GPL-3.0 (repository licence label). The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, optimisation.
